newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee regions to see some rain today-Somar.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee regions to see some rain today-Somar.

text.p: Brazil's coffee regions in north Parana and southwest Sao Paulo states should see rains of around 20 millimeters Thursday afternoon, local meteorologists Somar said in a regular weather bulletin.
In north Sao Paulo and the Cerrado and southern areas of Minas Gerais state, around 10 millimeters of rainfall is expected at the end of the day, Somar added.
The polar air mass which is to follow the cold front is very weak and therefore will not cause temperatures to drop to critical levels.
Minimum temperatures are forecast to be around five degrees Celsius in the coldest areas of Pocos de Caldas, Minas Gerais state, over the weekend and between 10 to 14 degrees in other coffee areas.
"Five degrees is warm, there is no cause for concern," said Somar forecaster Marcos Massari.
In the seven-day outlook, there is no forecast of any frosts for the coffee areas.
